FROM Master
WHERE LOWER(nameNick) IS NOT NULL

    SELECT playerID
    FROM AwardsPlayers
    WHERE award = 'All-Rookie'
  )

FROM HOF
WHERE LOWER(hofID) IN (
    SELECT playerID
    FROM Master
    WHERE birthMon IN ('7', '8')
);

SELECT MAX(birthMon) AS birth_month
FROM Master m
WHERE LOWER(m.playerID) IN (
    SELECT playerID
    FROM AwardsPlayers
    GROUP BY playerID
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT birthYear AS "Birth Year", COUNT(*) AS Total_Awards
FROM AwardsPlayers ap
JOIN Master m ON ap.playerID = m.playerID
GROUP BY birthYear
ORDER BY Total_Awards DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT birthCountry AS country, COUNT(*) AS award_count
FROM AwardsPlayers
JOIN Master ON AwardsPlayers.playerID = Master.playerID
GROUP BY birthCountry
ORDER BY award_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT birthCountry, COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Master
WHERE hofID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY birthCountry
ORDER BY player_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

JOIN AwardsPlayers AP ON M.playerID = AP.playerID

SELECT m.birthCountry || '-' || m.birthState || '-' || m.birthCity AS birth_place
FROM Coaches c
JOIN Master m ON c.coachID = m.coachID
WHERE c.year = 1998
  AND c.notes LIKE '%co-coach%';

SELECT firstName || ' ' || lastName AS full_name
FROM Master
WHERE coachID IN (
    SELECT coachID
    FROM Coaches
    WHERE stint = 3
);

FROM Master
WHERE height IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    SELECT SUM(CAST(ENG AS INTEGER))
    FROM Goalies
    WHERE playerID = Master.playerID
  ) >= 10
ORDER BY CAST(height AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    m.firstName,
    m.lastName,
    m.shootCatch
FROM Goalies g
JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE g.year = 2010
ORDER BY CAST(g.SHO AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Master.birthYear) AS INTEGER)) AS youngest_year
FROM Goalies
JOIN Master ON Goalies.playerID = Master.playerID
WHERE Goalies.year = 2002
  AND CAST(Goalies.GA AS INTEGER) > 150;

SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS fullName
FROM Goalies g
JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE g.tmID = 'NJD'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT tmID, name
FROM TeamsPost
WHERE year = 2010
ORDER BY PostENG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT tmID, Pts
FROM Teams
WHERE year = 1995
AND lgID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT lgID
    FROM GoaliesSC
    WHERE year = 1995
)
ORDER BY Pts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    m.nameNick AS coach_nickname,
    c.w AS wins,
    c.l AS losses,
    CASE 
        WHEN (c.w + c.l) > 0 THEN CAST(c.w AS REAL) / (c.w + c.l)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS winning_rate
FROM Coaches c
JOIN Master m ON c.coachID = m.coachID
WHERE c.year = 2009
    AND (c.w + c.l) > 0
ORDER BY winning_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS coach_name
FROM Coaches c
JOIN Teams t ON c.year = t.year AND c.tmID = t.tmID
JOIN Master m ON c.coachID = m.coachID
WHERE t.year = 2011
ORDER BY CASE 
    WHEN LOWER(t.PPG) != '' AND LOWER(t.PPC) != '' THEN CAST(t.PPG AS REAL) / CAST(t.PPC AS REAL)
    ELSE -999999999.0
END DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS years_in_finals FROM TeamsPost WHERE tmID IN (SELECT tmID FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'Stanley Cup Finals' AND year IN (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM TeamsPost));

SELECT SUM(S.G) AS total_goals
FROM Scoring S
JOIN Teams T ON S.year = T.year AND S.tmID = T.tmID
WHERE S.playerID = 'dyeba01'
  AND T.name LIKE '%Stanley Cup%'
  AND T.year = 1921;

FROM ScoringSC
WHERE ScoringSC.year IN (
    SELECT year
    FROM SeriesPost
    WHERE round = 'Stanley Cup Finals'
);

SELECT pos FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'hartgi01' AND year IN (SELECT year FROM TeamsSC WHERE tmID IN (SELECT tmIDWinner FROM SeriesPost WHERE round = 'Stanley Cup Finals'));

SELECT tmID, W FROM Teams WHERE year = 2011 AND lgID IN (SELECT DISTINCT lgID FROM GoaliesSC WHERE playerID IN (SELECT DISTINCT playerID FROM GoaliesSC WHERE year = 2011) GROUP BY playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT playerID) = 3);

SELECT MAX(Master.birthYear) AS birth_year
FROM Goalies
JOIN Master ON Goalies.playerID = Master.playerID
WHERE Goalies.year = 2008
AND Goalies.PostSA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(Goalies.PostSA AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Coaches 
WHERE coachID IN (
    SELECT playerID 
    FROM Master 
    WHERE lastName = 'Waddell' AND firstName = 'Don'
);

       MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(shootCatch) = 'r' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS righthand,
       MAX(CASE WHEN shootCatch IS NULL OR shootCatch = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both
FROM Goalies
WHERE year = 1996
ORDER BY CAST(SHO AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT firstName, lastName, birthYear, birthMon, birthDay
FROM Master
WHERE playerID IN (
    SELECT playerID
    FROM Goalies
    WHERE year = 1965
    ORDER BY CAST(GA AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT firstName, lastName FROM Master WHERE playerID IN (SELECT playerID FROM Scoring WHERE year = 1981 AND "+/-" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE("+/-", '+', '') AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT master.weight
FROM scoring
JOIN master ON scoring.playerID = master.playerID
WHERE LOWER(scoring.ppg) != ''
  AND scoring.year > 2000
ORDER BY CAST(LOWER(REPLACE(scoring.ppg, '(', '')) AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Master
WHERE playerID IN (
    SELECT playerID
    FROM Scoring
    WHERE year = 1989
      AND SHG = '7'
);

JOIN Master M ON C.coachID = M.coachID
WHERE T.year = 2003
ORDER BY CAST(T.BenchMinor AS INTEGER) DESC

SELECT g.playerID, m.lastName, m.firstName, m.weight, CAST(g.GA AS INTEGER) AS goal_against

JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE CAST(m.weight AS REAL) > 190

LIMIT 1;

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year > 2005 THEN w ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN year > 2005 THEN w + l ELSE 0 END)) - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2005 THEN w ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2005 THEN w + l ELSE 0 END)) AS improvement_percentage
FROM Coaches
WHERE tmID = 'VAN'
  AND coachID IN (SELECT coachID FROM Master WHERE lastName LIKE '%vigneault%' AND firstName LIKE '%alain%')
  AND year >= 2005;

SELECT 
    m.legendsID
FROM Goalies g
JOIN Master m ON g.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE g.year = 2011
    AND g.tmID IN (
        SELECT tmID 
        FROM Teams 
        WHERE year = 2011 
            AND playoff IS NOT NULL
    )
ORDER BY CAST((1.0 - (CAST(g.PostGA AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(g.PostSA AS REAL), 0))) * 100 AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.playerID) AS count FROM Master m JOIN Coaches c ON m.coachID = c.coachID WHERE m.pos IS NOT NULL;

SELECT award AS "Most Frequent Award"
FROM AwardsCoaches
WHERE coachID IN (
    SELECT coachID
    FROM Coaches
    GROUP BY coachID
    ORDER BY SUM(w) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year >= 1950 AND year <= 1980 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 30.0 AS avg_hof_players FROM HOF;

SELECT 
    birthCountry,
    COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Master
WHERE birthCountry IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY birthCountry
ORDER BY player_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t.W > 0 THEN t.W ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins
FROM Teams t
JOIN Goalies g ON t.year = g.year AND t.tmID = g.tmID
WHERE CAST(g.SHO AS INTEGER) > 0;

SELECT tmID, rW AS road_victories
FROM TeamSplits
WHERE year = 2005
ORDER BY rW DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT pos FROM Master ORDER BY CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER), CAST(birthMon AS INTEGER), CAST(birthDay AS INTEGER) LIMIT 8 OFFSET 1;

SELECT MAX(GA) AS max_goals_against
FROM Goalies
WHERE year = 1924
  AND lgID = 'WCHL';

SELECT OctL AS overall_number_of_october_defeats, tmID
FROM TeamSplits
WHERE year = 2006 AND lgID = 'NHL'
ORDER BY OctL DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Master
WHERE LOWER(shootCatch) LIKE '%left%' AND LOWER(shootCatch) LIKE '%right%'
   OR shootCatch IS NULL
  AND firstNHL = '2011';

SELECT 
    year AS record_year,
    MAX(CAST((CAST(strftime('%Y', '2000') AS INTEGER) - CAST(birthYear AS INTEGER)) AS INTEGER)) AS max_age_at_record
FROM (
    SELECT 
        s.year,
        m.birthYear
    FROM Scoring s
    JOIN Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID
    WHERE s.G > 0
) sub;

SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN pos = 'G' AND LOWER(birthYear) BETWEEN '1970' AND '1979' AND LOWER(shootCatch) = 'l' THEN CAST(height AS REAL) END) AS avg_height,
    tmID AS team_id,
    name AS team_name
FROM Master
WHERE pos = 'G'
  AND birthYear LIKE '197%'
  AND shootCatch = 'L'
GROUP BY tmID
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(Scoring.A) AS TotalAssists, Master.nameGiven || ' ' || Master.lastName AS FullName
FROM Scoring
JOIN Master ON Scoring.playerID = Master.playerID
WHERE Scoring.lgID = 'NHL'
GROUP BY Scoring.playerID
ORDER BY TotalAssists DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN t.PPG IS NULL THEN 'No Power Play Data' ELSE CAST(t.PPG AS REAL) / CAST(t.PPC AS REAL) * 100 END AS power_play_percentage,
    t.tmID AS team_id,
    tv.oppID AS opponent_team_id,
    CASE WHEN tv.W > tv.L THEN 'Victorious' ELSE 'Lost' END AS result
FROM Teams t
JOIN TeamVsTeam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.lgID = tv.lgID AND t.tmID = tv.tmID
WHERE t.PKC IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(t.PKC AS REAL) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.coachID, a.award, a.year
FROM Coaches c
JOIN AwardsCoaches a ON c.coachID = a.coachID
WHERE c.w = (SELECT MAX(w) FROM Coaches);
SELECT tmIDLoser AS LosingTeamName FROM SeriesPost WHERE year = 1912 AND note = 'EX';

SELECT 
    m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS fullName,
    (CAST(m.lastNHL AS INTEGER) - CAST(m.firstNHL AS INTEGER)) AS yearsPlaying
FROM Master m
JOIN Scoring s ON m.playerID = s.playerID
WHERE s.lgID = 'NHL'
  AND s."+" IN ('-', '+')
GROUP BY m.playerID
ORDER BY (CAST(m.lastNHL AS INTEGER) - CAST(m.firstNHL AS INTEGER)) DESC;

SELECT firstName AS given_name, MAX(GP) AS max_games_played
FROM Scoring
WHERE year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2005
  AND PIM BETWEEN 200 AND 250
GROUP BY playerID, firstName
ORDER BY max_games_played DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN AwardsPlayers.pos IS NOT NULL THEN AwardsPlayers.pos END) AS position,
    MAX(CASE WHEN AwardsPlayers.award IS NOT NULL THEN AwardsPlayers.award END) AS award_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Master.firstName IS NOT NULL AND Master.lastName IS NOT NULL 
                THEN Master.firstName || ' ' || Master.lastName 
             END) AS player_full_name
FROM AwardsPlayers
JOIN Master ON AwardsPlayers.playerID = Master.playerID
GROUP BY AwardsPlayers.pos
ORDER BY COUNT(AwardsPlayers.award) DESC, MAX(AwardsPlayers.year) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    t.name AS winning_team_name,
    opp.name AS opposing_team_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opp.tmID) AS number_of_opponents_played_against
FROM Teams t
JOIN TeamVsTeam tv ON t.year = tv.year AND t.tmID = tv.tmID
JOIN Teams opp ON tv.oppID = opp.tmID
WHERE t.year = 1915
    AND LOWER(t.name) != ''
GROUP BY t.tmID, opp.tmID
ORDER BY t.W DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.playerID,
    m.firstName,
    m.lastName,
    MAX(s.GWG) AS max_GWG
FROM Scoring s
JOIN Master m ON s.playerID = m.playerID
WHERE s.SHG BETWEEN 1 AND 5
GROUP BY s.playerID, m.firstName, m.lastName
ORDER BY max_GWG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT coachID, SUM(L) AS total_losses
FROM Coaches
WHERE year = 1997
  AND tmID = 'TBL'
  AND LOWER(notes) LIKE '%interim%';

SELECT MAX(T.rank) AS final_standing, T.year, T.name
FROM Teams T
JOIN Scoring SC ON T.tmID = SC.tmID AND T.year = SC.year
WHERE SC.SHA >= 7
GROUP BY T.year, T.tmID
ORDER BY SUM(SC.SHA) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.coachID, m.firstName || ' ' || m.lastName AS name
FROM Coaches c
JOIN Master m ON c.coachID = m.coachID
WHERE c.year = 1969
AND (c.tmID, c.year) IN (
    SELECT tmID, year
    FROM Teams
    WHERE year = 1969
    AND rank = 4
);
SELECT name FROM TeamsHalf WHERE year BETWEEN 1917 AND 1920 AND half = 1 AND rank = 1;

SELECT 
    firstName || ' ' || lastName AS CompleteName,
    year,
    tmID,

    FROM Master
    WHERE birthCountry = 'Canada'

        WHEN LOWER(name) LIKE '%edmonton%' THEN 'Edmonton'
        WHEN LOWER(name) LIKE '%los angeles%' THEN 'Los Angeles'

JOIN geo_mountain gm ON LOWER(c.Name) = LOWER(gm.Country)

SELECT MAX(DesertCount) AS MaxDeserts

    FROM country c
    JOIN geo_desert g ON LOWER(c.Name) = LOWER(g.Country)

);

SELECT d.Name AS Desert, c.Name AS Country
FROM desert d

SELECT COUNT(*) AS desert_count

    WHERE LOWER(l.Name) LIKE '%armenian%'

SELECT m.Name AS MountainName, m.Height AS Height

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count

JOIN geo_mountain gm ON LOWER(c.Name) = LOWER(gm.Country)
JOIN mountain m ON LOWER(gm.Mountain) = LOWER(m.Name)

SELECT MAX(b.Length) AS max_border_length

JOIN politics p2 ON LOWER(b.Country2) = LOWER(p2.Country) AND p2.Dependent IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count

SELECT Country1 AS Country_A, Country2 AS Country_B, Length AS Border_Length

SELECT SUM(e.GDP) AS total_gdp

SELECT Name, Area FROM desert WHERE (SELECT Name FROM continent) = 'America' ORDER BY Area DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM population p JOIN encompasses e ON p.Country = e.Country WHERE e.Continent = 'Europe' AND p.Infant_Mortality > 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM country c JOIN language l ON LOWER(c.Name) = LOWER(l.Country) WHERE LOWER(l.Name) = 'bosnian' AND (c.Population IS NULL OR c.Population <= 0);

SELECT AVG(e.Agriculture) AS avg_agriculture_percentage

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM country c JOIN politics p ON c.Name = p.Country WHERE p.Independence IS NOT NULL AND (c.Population / c.Area) > 5000;

SELECT AVG(e.Inflation) AS avg_inflation

SELECT

SELECT c.Name AS CityName, c.Population

SELECT

SELECT i.Name AS Island_Name, lo.City

SELECT c.Name AS City, p.Name AS Province, p.Capital AS Capital

SELECT c.Name AS CityName, c.Population AS CityPopulation

SELECT

JOIN city c ON gi.Country = c.Country AND gi.Province = c.Province

WHERE i.Type LIKE '%coral%';

SELECT AVG(c.Population) AS avg_population
FROM city c

JOIN geo_sea g ON l.Sea = g.Name

SELECT

FROM city c

WHERE c.Name = 'Edmonton';

SELECT r.Name AS RiverName

SELECT c.Name AS CityName, l.Name AS LakeName

JOIN lake l ON gl.Lake = l.Name

SELECT Name AS mountain_name, Height AS height

SELECT Name FROM mountain WHERE Height BETWEEN 2000 AND 4000;

SELECT r.Name AS RiverName, r.Length AS Length

SELECT DISTINCT c.Name AS City, c.Province

JOIN river r ON l.River = r.Name

SELECT m.Height, m.Longitude, m.Latitude

SELECT m.Name AS MountainName, m.Height

SELECT r.Name AS River_Name, r.Length AS River_Length

SELECT c.Name AS Country, p.Name AS Province, m.Height

SELECT r.Name, r.Length

SELECT AVG(m.Height) AS avg_height

SELECT MAX(city.Population) - MIN(city.Population) AS population_difference
FROM city
JOIN located ON city.Name = located.City AND city.Province = located.Province AND city.Country = located.Country
WHERE located.River = 'Seine';

SELECT 
    r1.Name AS River1,
    r1.Length AS Length1,
    r2.Name AS River2,
    r2.Length AS Length2,
    CASE 
        WHEN r1.Length > r2.Length THEN r1.Length - r2.Length
        ELSE r2.Length - r1.Length
    END AS Difference
FROM geo_river gr1
JOIN river r1 ON gr1.River = r1.Name
JOIN located l1 ON l1.City = 'Belgrade' AND l1.Country = r1.Country
CROSS JOIN geo_river gr2
JOIN river r2 ON gr2.River = r2.Name
JOIN located l2 ON l2.City = 'Belgrade' AND l2.Country = r2.Country
WHERE LOWER(l1.City) LIKE '%belgrade%' 
    AND LOWER(l2.City) LIKE '%belgrade%'
    AND r1.Name != r2.Name
GROUP BY r1.Name, r2.Name, r1.Length, r2.Length
ORDER BY Difference DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(c.Area) AS avg_area

SELECT c.Name AS Country, d.Longitude, d.Latitude

FROM religion r
JOIN encompasses e ON LOWER(r.Country) = LOWER(e.Country)

LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CASE WHEN c1.Name = (SELECT MAX(m.Height) FROM mountain m JOIN geo_mountain gm ON m.Name = gm.Mountain JOIN country c2 ON gm.Country = c2.Name) THEN c1.Population ELSE NULL END AS pop_tallest,
    CASE WHEN c2.Name = (SELECT MAX(m.Height) FROM mountain m JOIN geo_mountain gm ON m.Name = gm.Mountain JOIN country c3 ON gm.Country = c3.Name) THEN c2.Population ELSE NULL END AS pop_second
FROM country c1
JOIN country c2 ON c1.Name != c2.Name
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mountain m 
    JOIN geo_mountain gm ON m.Name = gm.Mountain 
    WHERE gm.Country = c1.Name AND m.Height = (SELECT MAX(m2.Height) FROM mountain m2)
) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mountain m 
    JOIN geo_mountain gm ON m.Name = gm.Mountain 
    WHERE gm.Country = c2.Name AND m.Height = (SELECT MAX(m3.Height) FROM mountain m3)
);

    (SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(l.Name) = 'english' THEN l.Percentage * c.Population ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(c.Population)) AS proportion
